title: Clock-lane administrative action
statement: For any timed control state $q$, optional Boolean value $b$, and movement sign $d$, the administrative action with successor state $q$, clock-lane instruction $(b,d)$, and no buffer-lane instruction equals the single-lane action that writes $b$ and moves by $d$ on lane $4$ of the six-tape machine.
replaced:
A timed administrative action that writes and moves only on the clock lane
coincides with the generic single-lane action on lane $4$ of the six-tape
machine.
